name: @optima-compliance/export
description: Render compliance obligations as iCalendar (RFC 5545) or CSV (RFC 4180).
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.
//publishConfig: A scoped package defaults to RESTRICTED, which fails on a free account with a misleading 402 — and npm answers 404 rather than 403 for a scope it will not confirm, so the error reads like a missing package while auth is fine. Set here rather than relying on `--access public` at the command line, so the flag cannot be forgotten by whoever publishes next.
//dependencies: The engine is pinned EXACTLY, never by range, for the reason the project file gives about rule packs: a caret would let two installs of identical code resolve different engines. It also has to be a version that actually exists on the registry — this package sat pinned at 0.1.0 while the engine reached 0.4.0, and publishing it that way would have handed consumers an engine predating the `formation-anniversary` cadence anchor, which returns NOTHING for the rules that use it rather than failing.
